messages:
Maya L: Heads-up: demo import hit 429s during embeddings load, customer on call.
Omar H: Route? tenant?
Maya L: /v1/embeddings, tenant: nova-pay (trial). Error: HTTP 429, x-request-id=ff3344, X-RateLimit-Remaining=0
DevOps-bot: Quota snapshot for nova-pay: global_budget=120000, used_10m=118500, per_route('/v1/embeddings').burst_left=0, inflight_limit=20
Tess R: They used 60 concurrent requests from UI to speed up. Trial buckets are small.
Omar H: Quick actions: 1) temp +150k token bump for 1h 2) tell client to cap concurrency to 8 and retry with backoff
DevOps-bot: Applied quota bump: new_global_budget=270000, expires_at=2495003723
Maya L: Customer retried and demo completed, they want follow-up on permanent limits.
Tess R: Follow-ups: DevEx add concurrency guidance, Sales ask if they want extended trial or dedicated demo. Closing for now.
